idea-plugin.name: GapGPT
idea-plugin.description:
Chat with Claude Code inside IntelliJ-based IDEs with full Persian (Farsi) / RTL support.

  • Right-to-left chat panel with correct bidi rendering of mixed Persian/English text
  • Bundled Vazirmatn font
  • Code blocks stay left-to-right, with Copy and Insert-at-caret buttons
  • Review Claude's proposed edits in the IDE diff viewer and accept / reject (or tweak) them
  • Approve or deny commands and tools right in the chat
  • Current file and selection are shared with Claude automatically
  • IDE diagnostics (errors / warnings), open editors and selection are available to Claude as tools
  • @-mention project files with autocomplete; insert @File#L1-99 references from the editor
  • Send the editor selection to Claude, or ask Claude to explain it
  • Uses your locally installed Claude Code CLI (your own login / subscription)

گفتگو با Claude Code داخل IDE با پشتیبانی کامل از زبان فارسی و راست‌به‌چپ.
